appearance.languageHint: Applies immediately to the entire application. Your choice is remembered across restarts.
appearance.coverageNote: All shipped languages are fully reviewed for this release.
appearance.themeHint: Match Windows follows the system light or dark setting in real time.

startup.autoStartDetail: Launch NEXUS after you sign in. This setting changes only after your confirmation.

appUpdate.title: NEXUS app update
appUpdate.restartHint: Updating saves state and stops current tasks. The app will install the update and reopen automatically.

states.installing: Saving state and installing. NEXUS will reopen automatically.

errors.download: Download or verification failed. The update was not installed. Retry when connected.
errors.install: Installation failed. Your data is preserved; retry or restart NEXUS.
